weather.note: 今天（8/22 週六）台北是「白天悶熱、午後要小心」的天氣：北部及宜花多雲到晴，高溫約 31–33°C、低溫約 27°C，但大氣不穩定、午後對流發展旺盛，台北市區與山區容易出現局部大雨或短延時豪雨。　南部受低壓帶與偏強西南風影響，整天有陣雨或雷雨、局部地區甚至有豪雨；這個天氣型態一路持續到下週一（8/24），下週二才會趨緩。　颱風沙德爾目前距離台灣還遠，氣象署說要到下週三路徑才會比較明確——現在不用緊張，但值得放在心上。　今天出門一定要帶傘。特別提醒：今晚 18:00 back number 台北小巨蛋第一場，散場時間正好是午後雷雨過後的濕滑時段，抓寬一點交通時間。

items.detail: 收件人戴穎倫，代收類別 140792，學校名稱國立成功大學，銷帳編號 4079925111005492，應繳金額 NT$29,670 整，繳款期限 115 年 09 月 07 日。　信裡提醒可到「臺灣銀行學費入口網－繳費單查詢」檢視詳細資料及補印繳費單；若尚未變更識別碼或初次使用，識別碼欄位預設值為學生生日（YYYMMDD 共 7 碼，YYY 為民國年）。　為什麼把它排第一：距離 9/7 還有 17 天，看起來很寬裕，但這種「期限遠、金額大」的信最容易被往後推到忘記，而學雜費逾期會直接影響選課與註冊。　建議動作：這個週末就直接線上繳掉，或至少先把繳費單印出來、把 9/7 排進行事曆。若要辦就學貸款或分期，記得那是另一套流程、截止日通常更早，要先去生輔組確認。

items.title: 📚 【二階選課即將開始】理工、電資領域同學可選修 115-1 跨領域課程
items.kind: 需要決策：要不要在二階把跨領域學分排進去
items.detail: 寄給理學院、工學院、電資學院及生科學院所屬同學。校方以 College X 作為跨領域支持平台，邀請人文、社科領域教師開設基礎課程，專門提供理工、電資領域學生選修，信中附上可選修之課程名單及海報。　訴求很直白：想修非本科領域的課常常搶不到、或根本不知道有哪些課可以修，這份名單就是幫你先篩過一輪、降低加簽被拒的疑慮。　對你的意義：化工系的課表本來就重，跨領域課通常是拿來調節學期節奏、順便補通識學分的好工具，但一定要在二階前就決定，因為二階一開跑，好的時段馬上被搶完。　建議動作：今天花 15 分鐘把附件名單掃一遍，圈出 2–3 門「時間不衝堂＋你真的想上」的候選，二階開放時直接送出。

items.title: 🧬 【AI 微學程】醫學 AI 素養與跨域創新微學程 — 115-1 開放選課，限額 60 名
items.kind: 需要決策：限額課程，想修就得快
items.detail: 醫學院全新開設「醫學 AI 素養與跨域創新微學程」，115 學年度第 1 學期首門課為《醫療人工智慧導論：技術與臨床場域概論》，開放選課，限額 60 名。　信中附上活動宣傳海報、三支課程簡介短影音（EP1／EP2／EP3）與完整版簡介影片（Instagram 版與 YouTube 版），也附上醫學院官方 Instagram、Threads、YouTube 與官網連結。　為什麼對你可能有價值：這是把 AI 放進具體應用場域（臨床）的課，比純理論的 AI 課更好寫進履歷，而且「微學程」代表修完有正式認證、不是單一堂課。對化工背景的人來說，醫療 AI 跟製程 AI 的骨架其實很像——資料前處理、特徵工程、模型驗證、法規限制——修這門課學到的方法論可以直接搬回本科。　風險：限額 60 名代表競爭激烈，而且微學程通常有後續必修課的連鎖承諾，要先確認未來幾學期排得下。

items.en: US Threatens 'Toughest Sanctions in History' on Iran as Bessent Prepares Monday Rollout
items.zh: 美國揚言對伊朗祭出「史上最嚴厲制裁」，財長貝森特週一公布細節
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the United States would impose the toughest sanctions in its history on Iran, arguing the measures would "collapse" the government in Tehran. He warned that other nations continuing to trade with Iran could face severe economic penalties of their own, a threat markets read as aimed squarely at China, a major buyer of Gulf oil. President Trump separately promised "tremendous economic consequences" for any country doing business with Iran. Bessent will detail the plan at a Monday press conference. The escalation lifted oil and gold and kept investors defensive through a volatile week.

items.en: Landmark Federal Trial Over Meta's Impact on Children's Mental Health Opens
items.zh: Meta 兒童心理健康世紀訴訟開庭，求償上看 1.4 兆美元
items.summary: Opening statements began this week in a California federal court in a landmark trial accusing Meta of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict children, damage their mental health and violate their privacy. Attorneys general from California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey are seeking financial penalties that could reach $1.4 trillion, plus court-ordered changes to how the platforms operate. A deputy California attorney general told jurors Meta built products to "hook the users, hold them, harvest their data, and then hide the truth" — and that the design worked "especially well for kids." Meta denies the claims.

items.en: At Least One Dead and 100+ Homes Damaged in Hawaii After Hurricane Lala
items.zh: 颶風 Lala 擦過夏威夷，至少 1 死、逾百戶房屋受損
items.summary: The Island of Hawai'i narrowly avoided a direct landfall when Hurricane Lala passed just south of it on August 15, but the storm still delivered torrential rain and destructive flooding. More than 100 homes on the Big Island were damaged or destroyed and tens of thousands of customers lost power. Governor Josh Green confirmed the body of a 90-year-old woman who "perished in the flood." Lala has since weakened and spun out to sea, and visitor operations have largely returned to normal, but recovery on the Big Island is expected to take weeks.

items.en: Nearly 30 Years On, the Only Person Charged in Tupac Shakur's Killing Goes on Trial
items.zh: 圖帕克命案近 30 年後開審，唯一被起訴者出庭
items.summary: Nearly three decades after rapper Tupac Shakur was gunned down in a drive-by shooting on the Las Vegas Strip in September 1996, the only person ever charged in his death has gone on trial. The case is one of the longest-running unsolved celebrity homicides in American history, and prosecutors are relying heavily on the defendant's own past public statements about the night of the shooting. Defence lawyers argue those accounts were self-promotional embellishment rather than confession. The trial is being closely followed as a test of how courts handle decades-old evidence and memory.

items.en: FBI Seizes Devices From Former Congressman Eric Swalwell in Civil Rights Probe
items.zh: FBI 查扣前眾議員史沃威爾手機與筆電，涉性侵指控調查
items.summary: FBI agents seized a cellphone and a laptop from former Congressman Eric Swalwell after stopping him at San Francisco International Airport, and the following day federal agents searched his home in Washington, D.C. The Justice Department describes the action as part of a civil rights investigation into allegations of sexual assault. No charges have been filed. Swalwell, a longtime critic of the current administration, has characterised the searches as politically motivated. The case has intensified an already fierce argument in Washington over the independence of federal law enforcement.

items.en: Nevada Clears Up to 5,000 Tesla Robotaxis for Las Vegas Streets
items.zh: 內華達州放行：特斯拉最多 5,000 台 Robotaxi 可上路拉斯維加斯
items.summary: Nevada regulators approved permits allowing Tesla to deploy up to 5,000 robotaxis in the Las Vegas area over the next year, while Waymo and Uber are each cleared for up to 1,000 vehicles. It is by far the largest single robotaxi authorisation granted in the United States and turns Las Vegas into the country's biggest live testbed for driverless ride-hailing. The decision lands as Nvidia pushes its Alpamayo reasoning model for autonomous vehicles, already adopted by Lucid, Jaguar Land Rover and Uber. Safety advocates have questioned the scale of the rollout.

items.en: Anthropic Aims to Match or Beat SpaceX's Record-Setting IPO
items.zh: Anthropic 目標超越 SpaceX，衝擊史上最大 IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is pushing to match or exceed the size of SpaceX's record initial public offering, which raised roughly $75 billion — the largest first-time share sale ever. The Claude developer submitted a draft registration statement to the SEC in June and is reported to be filing publicly before the end of August, targeting a listing as early as October. The company is currently valued near $1 trillion, and some investors are pencilling in valuations up to $2 trillion based on its projected end-2026 revenue run rate. Neither figure is confirmed.

items.en: Broadcom in Talks to Raise Over $60 Billion in Debt for AI Chip Buildout
items.zh: 博通洽談逾 600 億美元舉債，為 AI 晶片產能融資
items.summary: Broadcom is in discussions with a group of lenders to raise more than $60 billion in debt to finance AI semiconductor production, with some reports putting the potential package as high as $100 billion. Anthropic is named among the customers the capacity would serve. The talks are part of a broader wave in which chipmakers lined up tens of billions in fresh AI-linked debt this week. Broadcom expects AI semiconductor revenue to grow more than 200% year over year to roughly $16 billion in the current quarter. The stock closed Friday around $367.

items.en: Kelsey Mitchell Sets WNBA Record With 21st Straight 20-Point Game
items.zh: 凱爾希‧米契爾連 21 場破 20 分，創 WNBA 新紀錄
items.summary: Indiana Fever guard Kelsey Mitchell poured in a game-high 37 points against the Dallas Wings, extending her streak to 21 consecutive games with 20 or more points — a new WNBA record. The individual milestone came in a losing effort: Dallas took the game 91-85, damaging Indiana's positioning as the regular season enters its closing stretch. Mitchell's run has been built on volume three-point shooting and a heavy usage rate, and it has made her a genuine MVP candidate in a season otherwise dominated by team storylines.

items.en: Reds Rally Past Cardinals 5-4 to Take the Series in Cincinnati
items.zh: 紅人隊逆轉紅雀 5:4，主場系列賽五取三
items.summary: The Cincinnati Reds came from behind for the second consecutive game to beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4, claiming three of five in the downtown Cincinnati series. Back-to-back comeback wins over a division rival matter more than the raw numbers suggest at this point in the calendar, with both clubs still mathematically alive in a crowded National League wild card race. The Reds' bullpen, a season-long weakness, held the lead in the late innings for the second night running.

items.en: Ryan Fox Wins His First Career Major at the 2026 Open Championship
items.zh: 紐西蘭好手 Ryan Fox 拿下生涯首座大滿貫：2026 英國公開賽
items.summary: New Zealand's Ryan Fox captured his first career major title at the 2026 Open Championship, a breakthrough that had been a long time coming for a player who spent years as a consistent contender without a signature win. The victory reshapes the year-end world rankings and secures Fox exemptions into the sport's biggest events for the next several seasons. It is also a significant moment for New Zealand golf, which has produced few major champions, and caps a summer in which the Open field was unusually deep.

items.en: College Student Depression and Anxiety Decline for a Third Straight Year
items.zh: 大學生憂鬱與焦慮連續第三年下降 — Healthy Minds 全美調查
items.summary: The Healthy Minds Study, drawing on responses from more than 84,000 students nationwide, reports that college students are experiencing lower rates of depression, anxiety and suicidal thinking for the third consecutive year. Moderate-to-severe depression fell from 44% in 2022 to 37% in 2025, and suicidal ideation dropped from 15% to 11% over the same period. Researchers credit expanded campus counselling, greater openness about mental health, and distance from pandemic disruption — while cautioning that the remaining baseline is still far above pre-2015 levels.

items.en: School Psychologist Shortage: US Average Ratio Is Twice the Recommended Level
items.zh: 校園心理師嚴重不足：全美比例是建議值的兩倍以上
items.summary: The National Association of School Psychologists recommends one psychologist for every 500 students, but the US national average in the 2023-24 school year was 1,065 students per psychologist — more than double the target. The gap sits alongside survey data showing 40% of high school students reported persistent sadness or hopelessness and 20% said they had seriously considered suicide. Roughly one in five students report their mental health care needs are going unmet, with stigma, low awareness, treatment cost and counsellor availability identified as the four biggest barriers.

items.en: US Science Agency Withholds $1 Billion of Its Budget for a White House Project
items.zh: 美國科研補助機構扣下 10 億美元預算，改撥白宮特別專案
items.summary: The main US science-funding agency is withholding roughly $1 billion of its budget so the money can be redirected to a special White House project, a move that researchers warn will squeeze grants across university laboratories. Early-career scientists and graduate students are the most exposed, since their positions typically depend on multi-year federal grants that are the easiest line item to delay. The decision arrives alongside promising trial results suggesting cancer vaccines work and could be extended to other tumour types — research of exactly the kind that federal funding underwrites.

items.en: Anthropic Q2 Revenue Tops $11.5 Billion, Up More Than 14-Fold Year on Year
items.zh: Anthropic 第二季營收破 115 億美元，年增逾 14 倍、首度轉正
items.summary: Anthropic reported preliminary second-quarter revenue of more than $11.5 billion, against $787 million in the same quarter of 2025 and $4.73 billion in Q1 2026 — a more than 14-fold year-on-year jump. The quarter also delivered positive adjusted operating income for the first time in the company's history, a milestone no other frontier lab has publicly claimed. Anthropic has previewed Claude 5 "Fennec" and is doubling down on coordinated agent teams rather than raw model scale, a strategic bet that shows up directly in its enterprise API revenue mix.

items.en: Google's Gemini App Passes One Billion Monthly Users; Gemini 3.7 Flash Ships
items.zh: Google Gemini 月活躍破 10 億，3.7 Flash 主打程式與 Agent
items.summary: Google's Gemini app crossed one billion monthly active users on August 11, and two days later the company shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash, pitched squarely at coding and agent workflows. Koray Kavukcuoglu now oversees Gemini model development, Frontier AI research, and both the consumer app and developer teams. The release completes an unusual six-week window in which Anthropic, OpenAI and Google all shipped new workhorse tiers — Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash now carry the bulk of production API traffic between them.

items.en: OpenAI Previews 'Ultrafast' API Tier Running GPT-5.6 Up to 14x Faster
items.zh: OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 最快 14 倍、每秒 750 tokens
items.summary: OpenAI is previewing Ultrafast mode, a new API tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster than standard processing, reaching as much as 750 output tokens per second on Cerebras hardware. The tier targets latency-sensitive workloads — voice agents, live coding assistance and interactive tooling — where throughput matters more than peak reasoning depth. OpenAI also began rolling out "Sign in with ChatGPT" in beta on 29 July, an identity play that would put the assistant at the front door of third-party applications.

items.en: back number "Grateful Yesterdays Tour 2026" in Taipei — TONIGHT at Taipei Arena
items.zh: 🔥 back number 台北小巨蛋 8/22（六）、8/23（日）— 今晚就是第一場
items.summary: back number's first-ever Asian tour opens in Taiwan, with two nights at Taipei Arena on Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 August 2026. Doors open 16:30, show starts 18:00 on both nights. Tickets were sold by real-name lottery in April with a final general sale on 7 May, priced from NT$800 up to NT$5,280 (NT$400 accessible seating). The band chose Taipei as the opening stop of the whole tour. An official warm-up playlist has been released ahead of the shows. Tonight is night one — leave extra travel time, heavy afternoon rain is forecast.

items.en: Official HIGE DANdism Returns to Taipei Arena Aug 29-30, Pop-Up Store Already Open
items.zh: Official髭男dism 台北小巨蛋 8/29–8/30，快閃店 8/21 開跑、4 大台北限定商品
items.summary: Official HIGE DANdism play Taipei Arena on 29 and 30 August 2026 as part of their 2026 Asia Tour, one week after back number in the same venue. A limited pop-up store opened in Taipei on 21 August selling four Taipei-exclusive merchandise items ahead of the shows. Taipei tickets originally went on general sale on 16 April at noon and sold out quickly. For anyone without a ticket, the pop-up store is open to the public and is the realistic way to get the city-limited goods.

items.en: Vaundy ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026 "HORO" — Hong Kong Oct 3, Taipei Oct 31 & Nov 1
items.zh: Vaundy 亞洲巡演「HORO」：香港 10/3、台北小巨蛋 10/31–11/1
items.summary: Vaundy's first Asian arena tour, ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026 "HORO", runs through Seoul, Hong Kong, Taipei, Shanghai, Tokyo and Fukuoka. The Hong Kong date is Saturday 3 October at AsiaWorld-Arena Hall 1, starting 20:00. Taipei gets two nights at Taipei Arena: Saturday 31 October and Sunday 1 November. Taiwan tickets went through a real-name lottery on Ticket Plus, with results already announced — unpaid winning entries are forfeited. He has also announced a JAPAN ARENA TOUR 2027-2028, his largest domestic run yet.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Announce 6th Album for September 30 and First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張原創專輯 9/30 發行，睽違三年巡迴
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE have announced their sixth original full-length album for release on 30 September 2026, alongside their first arena tour in three years. The band has been one of the highest-charting acts in Japan across the past two years, and the three-year gap since their last arena run means demand for tickets is expected to be extreme. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates have been announced for this cycle so far — worth watching, since the album release usually precedes any Asia leg by several months.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu 2026 TOUR / GHOST — 14 Arena Shows Across 6 Cities, Nov 6 to Dec 17
items.zh: 米津玄師 2026 TOUR / GHOST：11/6–12/17，全國 6 城 14 場巨蛋級巡演
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's 2026 TOUR / GHOST runs from 6 November to 17 December 2026 across six Japanese cities for fourteen arena dates, including Port Messe Nagoya on 8 December. General lottery ticket applications ran from 7 to 26 July; the fastest presale serial numbers were bundled as a first-press bonus with every format of his 15th single "Plazma / BOW AND ARROW". No overseas dates have been announced. For Taiwan fans this is a fly-out tour — Nagoya and Fukuoka dates are usually the easiest to pair with cheap flights.

items.en: Yuuri Returns to Taipei Arena for Two Nights in October
items.zh: 優里 Yuuri 10 月台北小巨蛋連唱兩天
items.summary: Yuuri is scheduled to play Taipei Arena for two consecutive nights in October 2026, returning to the venue after his previous Taiwan run. He sits alongside Vaundy, XG, Eve, UVERworld, 羊文學, 中島健人, 山下智久 and 藤井風 on a notably crowded 2026 calendar of Japanese acts visiting Taiwan. Exact dates and the ticketing window should be confirmed through the official Taiwan promoter announcement — with three of your listed artists (back number, Official HIGE DANdism, Vaundy) already in Taipei this autumn, October may be a budget decision as much as a scheduling one.

market.asOf: 台股 2026/08/21（週五）收盤 · 美股 2026/08/21（週五）收盤 —— 今天 8/22 是週六，台美股皆休市，下一個交易日是 8/24（一）
market.note: 昨天（8/21 週五）台美兩邊剛好演出同一齣戲：指數本身漲得不多，但錢明顯在換位置。　【台股】加權指數開低走高，開盤 44,923.34、終場收 45,224.29 點、上漲 290.55 點（+0.65%），重新站回 45K，成交量約 7,192.8 億元。台積電收 2,410 元、漲 35 元（+1.47%），穩穩撐住指數；但真正的主角是航運——萬海亮燈漲停、陽明爆量 19.7 萬張大漲 6.14%、長榮也漲 2.24%，「大航海時代」的話題整個回來了。記憶體族群則是換了領頭羊：南亞科、華邦電只是力守紅盤，衝在最前面的變成模組廠創見（2451），盤中直接觸及漲停 312.5 元（+9.84%）。　【美股】道瓊收 53,276.81 點大漲 517.60 點（+0.98%），S&P 500 收 7,674.31（+0.43%），那斯達克收 26,180.46（+0.43%），羅素 2000 也漲 0.88%。看起來全面上漲，但這四個數字的排序本身就是訊息：道瓊與小型股 > 科技股，代表資金正在從 AI 大型股往其他地方擴散。Dow 成分股中漲最多的是高盛（+1.69%）、聯合健康（+1.48%）、美國運通（+1.46%），跌最多的是亞馬遜（-1.01%）、蘋果（-0.90%）、波音（-0.53%）。　【但三大指數整週仍是收黑的】本週前半段公債殺盤把風險資產壓得很慘，週四道瓊還一度重挫 703.84 點。財長貝森特週四宣布擴大公債買回計畫、單筆規模拉高到 40 億美元以上，殖利率只短暫回落就彈回原位，市場顯然認為這只是止痛藥。
market.highlight: 🆕 清單外四檔值得認識：　① 創見（2451）記憶體模組，8/21 亮燈漲停 +9.84%、收 312.5 元，接棒南亞科成為記憶體新領頭羊——如果你在追記憶體循環，領頭羊換人是很重要的訊號。　② 萬海（2615）貨櫃航運，Q2 獲利年增近 10 倍，昨天收漲停 +9.69%。　③ 陽明（2609）+6.14% 收 64 元、成交爆到 197,074 張、連 6 根紅 K。航運這波是「財報實績＋資金輪動」雙引擎，不是純題材股，但要注意法人已經在提隱憂：運價高點能撐多久沒人知道。　④ BitMine Immersion（BMNR），美股加密礦業/以太坊庫存策略股，隨比特幣衝上 7.7 萬美元大漲約 5–10%，是清單外最猛的加密代理股。
